ORDER BY (t.due_date IS NULL), t.due_date, t.progress DESC, t.board_column, t.sort_order, t.id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column <> 'done' AND t.priority = 'P0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS open_p0, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'backlog') AND (bc.processing_rule IS NULL OR bc.processing_rule NOT IN ('waiting', 'ended')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS doing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'backlog' OR (t.board_column <> 'done' AND bc.processing_rule = 'waiting') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS backlog, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column NOT IN ('done', 'backlog') AND bc.processing_rule = 'ended' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ended, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column <> 'done' AND t.due_date IS NOT NULL AND t.due_date < #{today} AND (bc.processing_rule IS NULL OR bc.processing_rule <> 'ended') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS `over`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column <> 'done' AND t.due_date = #{today} AND (bc.processing_rule IS NULL OR bc.processing_rule <> 'ended') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column <> 'done' AND t.due_date > #{today} AND t.due_date <= DATE_ADD(#{today}, INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND (bc.processing_rule IS NULL OR bc.processing_rule <> 'ended') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS soon FROM task t LEFT JOIN board_column bc ON bc.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND bc.id = t.board_column WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
AND t.req_id = #{reqId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT t.id, t.title, t.category_id, t.board_column, t.estimate_minutes, COALESCE(SUM(l.minutes), 0) AS total_minutes FROM task t LEFT JOIN time_log l ON l.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND l.task_id = t.id AND l.ended_at IS NOT NULL WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
AND t.estimate_minutes > 0 GROUP BY t.id, t.title, t.category_id, t.board_column, t.estimate_minutes, t.sort_order ORDER BY t.board_column, t.sort_order, t.id
SELECT FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND req_doc_id = #{reqDocId} ORDER BY board_column, sort_order, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND req_doc_id = #{reqDocId}
SELECT t.title FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.title IS NOT NULL

SELECT req_id AS req_id, COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN board_column = 'done' THEN 100 ELSE COALESCE(progress, 0) END), 0) AS progress_sum FROM task WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND req_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY req_id
